# 15. Competency {.unnumbered}

**Big Question:** *What kind of mentor have you become?*

## Looking Back {.unnumbered}

The final week is integration. Look back across your chapters: where did you sit relative to
the class, and where did your scores shift from pre to post?

## Reflect and Plan

::: {.callout-warning}
## Journal
- **Score:** Across the whole semester, where did you grow the most, and where do you still want to grow?
- **Behavior:** To be the best mentor you can be, what is one new thing you will try to do this week for mentees and/or your team?
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Your mentoring profile
Your completed chapters become a personal **mentoring profile** (also delivered as a printed
PDF). Use it to articulate your mentoring philosophy and your plan for future mentoring.
